vulnerabilities.sink_description: While parsing a crafted internal DTD, a one-byte constant (';') is written past the end of the buffer: `*(s = n + strcspn(n, EZXML_WS)) = ';';` with insufficient bounds checking on the DTD token region.

evidence.note: Reported against libezxml.a in ezXML 0.8.6; function and sink located directly in the dcb1748 tree.

vulnerabilities.sink_description: Out-of-bounds read while parsing a crafted XML file: after a strcspn scan reaches the end of the buffer, subsequent dereferences read past the input. Note: some secondary sources attribute this CVE to ezxml_internal_dtd; the OSV/SourceForge primary record names ezxml_parse_str, which is used here as the single ground-truth function so it does not collide with V1.

evidence.note: OSV description: `ezxml_parse_str()` performs incorrect memory handling (out-of-bounds read after strcspn failure) while parsing crafted XML files.
